## Professional Overview
Ritik Soni is a top-tier visual director and post-production executive with over 5+ years of dedicated craft experience. He bridges the gap between raw cinematic emotion and frame-accurate social media retention algorithms, having directed and edited over 100+ master cuts and amassed 50M+ organic impressions across digital platforms.

## Core Services & Capabilities
1. **Commercial Directing & Cinematic Production**: End-to-end concepting, storyboarding, live-action directing, cinematic lighting, and camera supervision for premium brands.
2. **Post-Production & Lead Editing**: Complex timeline editing in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Multicam syncing, kinetic pacing, dynamic speed ramps, and seamless invisible transitions.
3. **Full-Funnel Social Media Strategy (SMM)**: High-retention 9:16 short-form video architectures tailored for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.
4. **Broadcast Color Grading**: DaVinci Resolve Studio color conformity, ACES workflow, Rec.709 and HDR grading, custom LUT design, skin tone balancing.
5. **Sound Design & Audio Mastering**: Foley integration, sound effects layering, dialogue clean-up with iZotope RX, and LUFS broadcast mastering.
